description_en: We have a 2+1+2 typology apartment on 5 Maji Street, Tirana. Information about the apartment: • Apartment surface (gross): 116.6 m2 • 1st floor Organization: • Living room • Kitchen room • 2 Bedrooms • 2 Toilets • Balcony Other settings: • With elevator. • With mortgage. • The apartment is located in one of the best areas, offering all the necessary facilities. •The internal organization of the property also offers the very practical possibility to divide it into a 1+1 apartment and a studio
